async package_data_sourcer_task.api_data_sourcer.api_data_receiver()¶

Get data from hardcoded (maybe for now) API. Writes final_data.csv in a directory where the python script was run. If API returns 429 too many requests, the script sleeps for 3 minutes. Else if returns any other error it just dies.

Even this is a try of doing asynchronous code, I need more understanding of how does it work.
